name: Rocket Car Parts
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Rocket Car Parts lie scattered across the Shimmering Flats after racers crash. Kravel Koalbeard pays travelers to gather the wreckage and sell it back to rival crews.

sections.title: Debris on the Salt Flats
sections.body: Goblin and gnomish engineers race to outdo one another across the Shimmering Flats. Their experimental rocket cars often fail at speed. Twisted gears, cylinders, and jagged metal scatter over the white desert. As pit crews build and tune their next machines, the salt flats gather what the racers leave behind.

sections.title: Koalbeard's Salvage Enterprise
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard makes his profit as a middleman at the Mirage Raceway instead of competing on the track. Gnome and goblin mechanics use parts quickly and are always short of spare mechanisms for their vehicles. So Koalbeard pays travelers to gather thirty bundles of shattered debris. He turns each crash into stock he can sell back to the crews.

faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard is a dwarf merchant at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats. He pursues several schemes around the track, scavenging and taking odd jobs while profiting from gnome and goblin rivalries.

faq.q: Why are there so many rocket car parts scattered on the ground?
aliases: why are there car parts in the desert
faq.answer: Goblin and gnomish engineers push experimental rocket vehicles hard at the Mirage Raceway. Their crashes and sudden explosions scatter structural fragments, gears, and cylinders across the salt pans.

faq.q: What does Kravel do with the wrecked parts?
aliases: what does kravel want with parts
faq.answer: Koalbeard gathers the scrap and sells it back to the gnome and goblin race teams. Their crews use materials quickly and are eager to buy parts for their next prototypes.

aliases: where to find rocket car parts
faq.answer: The parts lie across the open desert floor of the Shimmering Flats, around the central racing camp. Among the heaps are mechanical scrap, twisted gears, cylinders, and flattened metal plates.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into other tasks around the raceway?
aliases: quests to do with rocket car parts
faq.answer: Yes. Travelers can gather parts while culling local wildlife for other raceway patrons. That work includes collecting venom from scorpid stingers and turtle shells, and thinning out buzzards and basilisks across the salt pans.

faq.q: What happens to the drivers involved in these wrecks?
faq.answer: Rocket car racing is lethal, and many pilots die on their test runs. While sorting scrap, Koalbeard finds a severed ear crushed between metal plates.

angles.text: The salt flats show the reckless ingenuity of goblin and gnomish designs. Unstable rocket boosters and improvised chassis often fail with a crash.
As a dwarf, you may see a mercenary streak in Kravel Koalbeard. Many Ironforge dwarves look to the raceway for mechanical innovation or excavation, but he cares only for the coin salvage brings.
As a gnome, you can see the relentless drive to outpace and out-innovate goblin competitors on the open track. Sometimes that effort ends in disaster.
